scope: Independent read-only review of two repository inputs plus local guide; no GitHub write or Windows execution.
decision: No blocking issue in reviewed upload workflow and guide; remote build readiness is conditional on actual GitHub Actions execution.
staticChecks: Pinned released ZIP SHA-256 must match before Expand-Archive or executing kit code.
The reviewed fixed ZIP has exactly one expected root and no unsafe, duplicate, case-colliding or symlink entries.
Extraction requires an absent dedicated runner.temp destination and the expected Build-Windows.cmd.
The called CMD and PowerShell bytes match the previously reviewed final scripts; no source or script mutations occur in the wrapper.
Workflow permissions are contents:read, triggers are push paths and workflow_dispatch, and execution does not publish a GitHub release.
The immutable ZIP is uploaded first; the text is committed as .github/workflows/build-windows.yml, not uploaded as a root .txt file.
Node 24 setup and stable Windows MSVC target precede the shared CMD native-tools initialization and locked build/test path.
Only finalized artifacts plus report/build log are uploaded; candidate-artifacts and work-source are excluded.
Guide distinguishes a build kit from a Windows executable, an Actions success from actual installation/live interaction, and private repository ownership from current connector access.
No PAT/password, public-repository conversion, shared-account authentication change, or remote action is requested by the guide.
limitations: PowerShell/CMD and this workflow have not been executed on a Windows runner.
GitHub Actions availability, quotas, repository policy and dependency downloads can still block the build.
The current connector cannot be assumed to read the user-created private repository or monitor its jobs; the guide uses the user browser.
A generated installer would still require Windows installation, WebView2, capture, hotkey and input validation.
Exact ZIP integrity is reviewed; dependency/action versions and remote toolchain installation are not made immutable by the source ZIP.
